no_upload: You may not send files to this bot.
unsupported: I cannot read this kind of message. Please send text, a photo, a file or a voice message.
too_long: That message is too long. Please send less than 8,000 characters.
rate: Too many messages: please wait a minute.
unavailable: This bot is not available right now.
no_answer: The agent had nothing to say.
interrupted: The agent was interrupted. Please send your message again.
failed: The agent stopped because of an error.
folder_limit: This agent cannot start because its file access exceeds the folder limit. Ask an administrator to reduce the shared folders available to you, then try again.
no_folder: This agent cannot work right now: its folder is missing.
no_file: I could not read the file you sent.
no_file_ability: I cannot take files on this platform.
file_type: I cannot read files of this type here.
file_total: Those files are too large together: please send fewer of them.
no_files: I can only read the text of your message here: files are turned off.
no_listen: I cannot listen to voice messages here: no speech-to-text model is set up. Please write your message.
no_transcript: I could not understand your voice message. Please send it again, or write it.
new.done: Started a new chat. I will not see our earlier messages.
new.each: Every message here already starts a new chat.
new.shared: Only a paired account can start a new chat here, because everyone in this conversation shares it.
new.busy: I am still answering. Send the command again when I am done.
pairing.done: Paired. This account can now use the sensitive features that you enabled for this bot.
pairing.bad: That code is not valid. It may have expired or been used. Ask for a new one.
pairing.full: This bot already has the most paired accounts. Remove one in the settings, then pair again.
pairing.direct: Pairing works in a direct message only.
file.too_big: That file is too large{seen}: I can read files of up to {max} here ({why}).
file.send_too_big: {name} is too large to send here (the limit is {limit}). It is in the chat's files.
file.more: {n} more files are in the chat's files.
file.made_not_sent: I made {name}, but files of this type are not sent here.
file.type_not_sent: {name} was not sent: files of this type are not sent here.
file.stays: {name} stays in the chat's files: the files of this answer are too large together.
file.promise: I could not attach the file. Ask me again and I will send it.
proposal.gone: That proposal expired. Ask again if you still want it.
proposal.place: Answer in the same place where it was proposed, or open Studio.
proposal.no_right: Only a sender the owner trusts can answer a proposal from here. Open Studio to answer it.
proposal.multi: More than one is waiting here. Say which, for example "confirm CODE" or "cancel CODE":
change.no_right: Only the owner can confirm this.
change.not_you: Only the person who asked can confirm this.
change.flagged: This text looks like it holds a secret, so it cannot be confirmed from a chat. Open the proposal in the web interface to check it.
change.saved: Saved: {summary}. Reply "undo" within {minutes} minutes to take it back.
change.done: Done: {summary}. Reply "undo" within {minutes} minutes to take it back.
change.kind.profile: a change of the rules of this agent
change.kind.dashboard: a change of the Home dashboard
change.propose_knowledge: I can add a text to your Knowledge, in the collection "{collection}": {summary}
change.knowledge_done: Added to {collection}: {summary}. Reply "undo" within {minutes} minutes to take it back.
change.ask: Nothing is saved until you answer. Reply "yes" to save it or "no" to drop it, here, within 24 hours. If more than one waits, reply "confirm {code}" or "cancel {code}".
trigger.where.channel: {channel}, at the top of the channel
trigger.cost.each: one model run each time it runs
trigger.not_asked: I did not start it by myself: {note}.
trigger.auto:
Set up {name}: {when}. Cost: {cost}. Results go to {where}.{end}
To remove it, reply "cancel" here, or "cancel {code}" at any time.
trigger.lifetime: {name} reached the end of its lifetime and was removed.
trigger.failed_n:
{name} failed {n} times in a row: {reason}
Fix or pause it in Studio.
acts.read_only: Permissions: read only. A run can read and report, and cannot change anything. {next}
acts.next_ask: Ask me to let it act, or change it later on the Triggers page.
acts.next_page: You can change this later on the Triggers page.
acts.with: Permissions: with nobody present, a run may {list}. Say no if that is more than you want.
act.word.files: write files in the agent's folders
act.word.addons: use the actions of the agent's add-ons
act.word.send: send messages beyond where it reports
act.word.spend: use paid or external tools and the network
act.addon: use the actions of the add-on {id}
verdict.not_readonly: it does not say that its runs only read and report
verdict.dropped: some acts it asked for are not allowed here
verdict.readonly_acts: its runs ask for permission to act on their own
verdict.not_allowed: its runs would {act}, which the owner has not allowed to start without a yes
verdict.paired: its runs would act on their own, and that needs a sender paired with this connection
verdict.channel: it would write to another channel
verdict.files: a trigger on files always asks
verdict.count_fail: I could not count the timers of this connection
verdict.too_many: this connection already has {n} timers and triggers (the most is {max})
verdict.far: it is more than {days} days away
verdict.gap: it runs every {gap} (the least is {min} minutes)
verdict.runs: it would make {n} runs a day with the others (the most is {max})
when.monthly: On day {day} of every month at {time}
refuse.channel: This channel is set to answer only, so I cannot do that for you here. Ask the owner to add you to the allowed people, or to let everyone in this channel ask for actions.
refuse.unlisted: Only people the owner added to this bot can do that, and you are not one of them.
refuse.pairing: Only people the owner paired with this bot can do that.
refuse.off: The owner has not turned that on for this bot.
